name: GET /api/leadflow/failures/dlq - what is stuck, from both queues
description:
The dead-letter queue, merged from sdk-connectors and sdk-webhook, plus the local unresolved failures (4cc3f597-f6c8-4dc5-8044-096ce144e676#AC1). They are different queues for different failures - an inbound connector that could not deliver, and an outbound webhook that could not be delivered - and an operator asking "what is stuck" means both. Two screens means one of them goes unwatched.

AN UNREACHABLE SOURCE IS NAMED, never silently omitted. An empty DLQ and a DLQ that could not be read look identical, and only one of them is good news - so unreachable_sources and a complete flag are returned alongside the items.

THE RUNBOOK IS RETURNED WITH THE QUEUE, so an operator reading a stuck item can see which fallback applies and who owns it without opening a second document. QA: measured live.
